human_answerability: Not guaranteed; this package intentionally tests failure when the decisive feature is hidden.

appendage_face_relation.decisive_feature: long handgrip attachment at one spoke/rim region
appendage_face_relation.occlusion_intent: keep the handgrip behind the rim and spokes in every view; expose only a partial silhouette
appendage_face_relation.question_focus: relative attachment and opposite-face placement of the two appendages

centered_vs_offset.decisive_feature: relationship of both cylindrical appendages to the central opening
centered_vs_offset.occlusion_intent: avoid a full side-cylinder view; retain only narrow partial witnesses
centered_vs_offset.question_focus: centered hub extension versus rim-offset handgrip

end_to_end_depth_order.occlusion_intent: keep both appendages close to the rim silhouette to make depth order ambiguous
end_to_end_depth_order.question_focus: near-to-far ordering of hub, rim, and handgrip

front_back_swap.decisive_feature: opposite placement of handgrip and hub extension
front_back_swap.occlusion_intent: use opposing oblique views without exposing either appendage end-on
front_back_swap.question_focus: which appendages exchange near/far sides under a flip

grip_spoke_registration.occlusion_intent: place the contact region behind a rim edge in all four views
grip_spoke_registration.question_focus: handgrip registration against the repeated spoke layout

one_spoke_shift.decisive_feature: handgrip location relative to repeated wheel geometry
one_spoke_shift.occlusion_intent: hide the grip in every view; the answer requires cross-view counterfactual reasoning
one_spoke_shift.question_focus: asymmetric feature after a one-spoke transformation

opening_continuity.decisive_feature: far-end witness of the central opening
opening_continuity.occlusion_intent: use edge-biased views that show only a partial dark opening
opening_continuity.question_focus: whether the central circular feature continues through the hub

repeat_breaker.occlusion_intent: hide the grip behind the near rim so repeat-breaking evidence is indirect
repeat_breaker.question_focus: feature that breaks the repeated spoke transformation

sector_boundary_pattern.occlusion_intent: use grazing views so several openings collapse into narrow slivers
sector_boundary_pattern.question_focus: repeated wheel openings and their boundaries

shared_depth_direction.decisive_feature: central opening and partially hidden handgrip
shared_depth_direction.occlusion_intent: use signed-Y edge families so both direction witnesses are weak but nonzero
shared_depth_direction.question_focus: shared front-to-back direction versus centered/offset placement

occlusion_protocol: Strict adversarial occlusion: the decisive feature is maximally hidden in all four question-owned views.
scope: Final-B-Rep-derived categorical labels and image-only visual/spatial reasoning. No code, measurements, dimensions, or modeling history are released to an evaluator.
question_variant: V9 triad-free relative-spatial stems with six labeled choices A-F and balanced correct-label schedule
ground_truth_answer_format: A-F label followed by exact answer text
